Listen to this article Share Football fans have praised Nigeria’s U-17 women’s team, the Flamingos , following their 2-0 victory over Puerto Rico at the ongoing FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco, urging the players to sustain their momentum in their final group match against North Korea. The result has further strengthened Nigeria’s hopes of progressing to the knockout stage, with fans in Aba, Abia State, urging the team to remain focused and clinical in front of goal against their highly rated opponents. Read Also: Flamingos beat Puerto Rico 2-0 to boost U-17 World Cup hopes Amarachi Amaechi, a football enthusiast, urged the Flamingos to approach the decisive encounter with determination, warning against being intimidated by North Korea’s impressive scoring record. “Although North Korea may have scored many goals in its first two matches, that does not mean the same approach will work against Nigeria. “The Flamingos should remain focused and aim for at least a draw to improve their chances of progressing to the next round, especially after North Korea thrashed Poland 6-1 in its second match,” Amaechi said. Similarly, Chimobi Onuoha expressed optimism about Nigeria’s chances of advancing, noting that North Korea had already secured qualification for the next round. However, he cautioned the Flamingos against complacency after their victory over Puerto Rico, stressing that North Korea could still field a strong side in the final group match. Another football fan, Chidinma Eke, commended the team’s performance and urged the technical crew to select its strongest available players for the decisive fixture. Eke expressed confidence in Nigeria’s ability to overcome the challenge through discipline, determination and concentration, adding that the players should give their best regardless of the pressure surrounding the match. Nigeria and Poland are level on three points, making the final group fixtures crucial to their hopes of advancing in the competition. The Flamingos will need to deliver another disciplined performance against North Korea as they seek to secure progression to the knockout stage.
